_why: protection programme rules (commons since reconcile-01, DEC-core-0011). Station quarantine stays the study owner of the held evasion tools; the pack and the self-check are commons.

rules.headline: The defensive self-check runs only on the operator's own sites (loopback, a local build, or a host in the station's work/protection/OWNED.txt), never a broker/exchange host, with no override; evasion tooling never leaves quarantine
rules.earned_by: design/QUEUE.md Q4 rails (operator 2026-10-16): 'targets for any self-test are the operator's own only'; 'anything that touches broker/exchange accounts is out of scope'; 'evasion tooling never leaves quarantine' (R-quarantine-own-targets, DEC-quarantine-0006)
